text_block_list.text:
"Daring Heart had sought change for the 
sake of victory. However, we concluded 
that to win, she should instead make use 
of her strength— her front-running 
ability."

"However, trying to stay at the front 
takes a huge toll on stamina just to 
maintain speed. Do that, and you'll throw 
away the advantage you worked so hard to 
gain."

To maintain the lead, one must learn to 
control their pace properly—in other 
words, adopt a running style that 
minimizes exhaustion.
choice_data_list: (There has to be a hint somewhere...)

text_block_list.text:
My specialty is analysis and research. So, 
I decided to watch and analyze tons of 
races from the Umamusume competing on the 
front lines.

—At any rate, I watch a huge amount of 
training and race footage. Regardless of 
era, distance, or running style, in 
massive quantities...
choice_data_list: (Who looks like a good reference... —Hm?)

text_block_list.text:
Just then—a sudden sense of déjà vu washed 
over me watching a certain Umamusume... 
no, watching several Umamusume run. It 
felt strikingly familiar—
choice_data_list:
...Does it feel similar to Heart's running 
style?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flower-chan. Thank you so much for the 
other day~.

Grass Wonder... A legendary Grand Prix 
Umamusume with consecutive Arima Kinen 
victories to her name.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Thank *you*... for arranging the 
flowers I grew so beautifully... Thank you 
so much.

Nishino Flower... the "Oka Sho" Umamusume. 
A sprinter boasting immense speed.
choice_data_list: (And one more person...)

text_block_list.text:
"Believe had victories in both the 
Sprinters Stakes and the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen. She, too, made a name for herself 
as a steadfast sprinter."
choice_data_list: (I can feel the "heart" coming from them.)

text_block_list.text:
Each of them had different personalities 
and strengths. Yet somehow—the heart 
behind their running left a strikingly 
similar impression.
choice_data_list: (…Let's go see it for ourselves.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Fuh... ngh, haaaaahhhh!!
choice_data_list:
(She's fast...! And what's more—she's not 
slowing down!)

text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining top speed is difficult. 
Normally, stamina runs out and you 
decelerate— but she was different."
choice_data_list:
(She can run all the way to the end 
without expending too much stamina.)

text_block_list.text:
And the same was true for the others. 
Though they didn't necessarily have 
endless stamina, they managed their 
exhaustion brilliantly.

If Daring Heart could master their 
techniques—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Do you have business with me?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. I have a favor to ask—
...Yeah. I have a favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A Tandem Training Roadmap for Controlling 
Stamina Depletion"...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Running with Flower, Grass-san, and 
Believe-san... to hone an energy-efficient 
running style, is it? ...That's quite an 
eclectic group, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: No, they're—they're just like you.
No, they're... just like you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list:
I've compiled the details into a paper, so 
read it later.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A thesis—wow, that's a massive amount of 
text... Okay, I see you have solid 
reasoning to back it up.
choice_data_list: You possess the same power they do.
You possess the same power they do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In other words, through running 
together, we'll awaken the inexhaustible 
technique within me. Is that about right?

"All that needs doing is finding and 
polishing the talent she already 
possesses. But, if we can train her 
according to this plan—"
choice_data_list:
You can win just by running the way you 
always do!
You can win just by running your way!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: ...Besides,

text_block_list.text:
I recall Daring Heart's lively running 
style. Captivated by her strides, I 
pursued her... and that led to signing our 
trainer contract.
choice_data_list: Your running... it's just... um...
The way you run is... well...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well? C'mon, tell me!
choice_data_list: ...I love your brave running style.
...I love how brave your running is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list:
I want to watch over you just the way you 
are.

I want to watch over you just the way you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A calm, solid plan... combined with your 
unexpected passion.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Something like this—I've got no choice but 
to take it head-on.
choice_data_list: Then...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on the challenge. —Staying true 
to myself!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for your 
cooperation, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. I should be the one thanking 
you for giving me such a good opportunity 
to hone myself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"To think I could be of help to 
Heart-san... I'm so, so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...It's time. Shall we begin?"
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm smaller than the other girls... 
there were times when it took everything I 
had just to keep up, and at first it used 
up a lot of my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I'm not feeling too confident 
in my physical strength either.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh, really? Heart-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Still, don't you worry! I'll run 
alongside you and show you!

From Nishino Flower, I learn how to think 
and respond to physical disadvantages... 
energy-conserving techniques to cover for 
weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, you're so dependable...! I'm 
counting on you, big sis!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good work~. How did it feel? —The 2,500 
meters, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Just finishing the race feels pretty 
tough... If the pace picks up on top of 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it will be quite a battle of 
attrition. However, how well we can hold 
on... how much we can endure will be the 
key, I believe.

From Grass Wonder, you learn how to make 
the most of limited stamina... and how not 
to burn out through proper pacing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then... this time I'll join you. Please, 
do try and keep up~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! Okay, challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I read your paper, Trainer. You wrote that 
my running style and yours are similar...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
âIndeed, I believe so too. Not through 
logic... but as an intuition.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
To take the lead and hold on stubbornly... 
having the endurance to sustain a dash 
state is crucial.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, of course... the key will be 
how well you conserve stamina while 
running."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
――Allow me to share it with you. The 
technique to maintain a sprint without 
depleting your stamina―― My method... my 
craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. Truly...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: But... why are you helping me this much?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm the only one benefiting 
here... There's nothing in it for the rest 
of you, is there?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ... I told you, I read the paper.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's why.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It was a very thorough paper, leaving no 
detail overlooked in its descriptions.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It was easy to understand immediately... 
just how vital our work is to Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...'I want to polish my trainee's running 
to perfection.' The depth of your 
resolve—is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we... get started too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And so, with the help of the other 
Umamusume, Daring Heart slowly began to 
awaken the power sleeping within her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaahhhhhh...!!
choice_data_list: Don't drop your speed!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! Aaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Isn't this... less painful than 
usual...?
choice_data_list:
You're able to maintain your top speed for 
longer now.

text_block_list.text:
By mastering the art of not wearing 
herself out, Daring Heart was performing 
more freely than ever, unleashing her full 
potential to her heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I'm... truly evolving, aren't I?
choice_data_list: Well then, that's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! Good work today!
choice_data_list: Please get some good rest.
Take your time and get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right, I ran so much today that 
I'm completely exhausted! So, I want to 
take a nice, relaxing rest."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —With you. ...May I?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Were my manners bad just now? Well, 
it's just the two of us, so it's fine!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You can't go wrong with pizza for a 
late-night snack! And store-bought pizza 
at that♪"
choice_data_list:
You didn't have to go all the way to the 
dorm to bring it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because this is faster than getting 
delivery, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you want to drink? Cola, as 
always? Or ice tea?
choice_data_list: Tea is fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Why with me?
Why with me?

text_block_list.text:
She said she was completely exhausted. If 
so, she should head straight back to the 
dorm and rest. So why now—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh! I am resting. Right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Upon a perch—meant just for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's toast one more time! Come on, 
grab something to drink too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...To our growth, cheers!"
